San Francisco IFR Clearance Phraseology Practice 2 (SFOW)
Instructions: for each of the following flight plans, practice the full phraseology you would use when giving a voice clearance to the aircraft. Use full route clearance phraseology. All of the routing is correct, nothing needs to be amended.
